wave 10: step guard, grant subjects, scorecard
wave 11: records reach base, binary revision

svg.text: tokens, one run (rN = resumes; bar = median)
refused before the first step, no tokens
tokens, one run of a candidate revision of an improvement turn, scored against the revision before the turn marker
Data: 2026-10-18 (UTC), docs/metrics/scenario-runs.jsonl, 57 runs. One scenario, n per revision under its label: first results, not a benchmark.
Untimed revisions have no wall time; tokens are summed over the invocations that reached the merge approval, resumes included.
